recreation_brief: 1) Draw a white slide with a thin black rectangular frame around the entire canvas. 2) Place the title 'Gradient Descent' in bold red sans-serif at the top-left. 3) In the left column, add the two weight-update equations and the delta definition, coloring 'Updated', 'old', and 'Where' in red. 4) Below that, add the error formula E = 1/2 sum (t_j - O_j)^2, then the sigmoid activation line with 'For Sigmoid Activation' in blue, then Net_j = sum (w_ji O_i). 5) Add a horizontal row of three derivative identities across the center. 6) Below that, add the three-line chain-rule derivation, ending with the delta_j definition and the parenthetical '(delta_j depends on j ONLY)'. 7) At the bottom-left, add the final Delta_ji equation with the 'for output Layer' note. 8) In the top-right, draw the neural network: three vertical columns of circles (3 input, 4 hidden, 3 output), each containing a Sigma symbol; add small '1' bias circles at the bottom of the first two columns; connect every node to every node in the next column with black arrows. 9) To the right of the output column, stack the labels 'Output 1/2/3', 'Error Output', and 'Class 1/2/3'. 10) Add a yellow circle with black '10' at the extreme top-right. 11) Add small 'Slide Notes' text at the bottom-left of the diagram. 12) In the bottom-right, draw a bordered box containing the three recap derivatives, with the first in red. 13) Use black for all body equations, red for emphasis terms, and blue for the sigmoid activation label.
